preconditions.expression: isinstance(grid, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: grid is a list of lists representing a 2D grid.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(grid[0]) for row in grid) if grid else True
preconditions.description: All rows in the grid have the same length (rectangular grid).

preconditions.expression: all(cell in ('X', 'O') for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid contains either 'X' or 'O'.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= len(grid) <= 100 and (0 <= len(grid[0]) <= 100 if grid else True)
preconditions.description: The dimensions n (rows) and m (columns) satisfy 1 <= n, m <= 100.

postconditions.description: The return value is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len([i for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, cell in enumerate(row) if cell == 'X' and not any((ni, nj) in visited for ni, nj in [(i-1, j), (i+1, j), (i, j-1), (i, j+1)] if 0 <= ni < len(grid) and 0 <= nj < len(grid[0)]))]) if (visited := set()) else 0
postconditions.description: The return value equals the number of connected components of 'X's, where connectivity is defined by horizontal or vertical adjacency (excluding diagonals).
